quests.title: The Crown Lamp

find.text: A root-totem at the trunk's base has been drilled with a dozen small holes. In each a pale glass splinter glows faintly. A tag in Bosmer script: 'The crown is thirsty. Feed it names.'

quests.desc: A root-totem studded with glass splinters at the base of the great tree says the crown is thirsty and must be fed names.
quests.pitch: The totem-carvers say the great tree's glow has dimmed one shade each season.

objectives.text: Copy a ring of name-plates from Ne Salas and take it to the star-vault.
Re-light the dark stars in the Reliquary and take the scroll to Elden Root.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The lamp's trail dips into an underground tower-city and a star-vault, climbs the tree's capital, and ends in a bone-walled ossuary.

consequence.summary: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The lamp's trail dips into an underground tower-city and a star-vault, climbs the tree's capital, and ends in a bone-walled ossuary.

quests.title: The Crown Lamp (II)
quests.desc: The lamp's trail dips into an underground tower-city and a star-vault, climbs the tree's capital, and ends in a bone-walled ossuary.
quests.pitch: The totem-carvers say the great tree's glow has dimmed one shade each season.

objectives.text: Open the keepers' hall and read the debate's ballot.
Read the lamp-warden's name at the lowest tier and relight the crown.

quests.outro: I laid the last name in the ossuary's tier and the glow in the crown flickered up like a lit wick. The Pact's keepers will be less grateful than I hoped. The lamp, though, burned bright.

consequence.summary: I laid the last name in the ossuary's tier and the glow in the crown flickered up like a lit wick. The Pact's keepers will be less grateful than I hoped. The lamp, though, burned bright.

quests.title: Where the City Walks

find.text: An inn's travel-board lists the walking city's seasons, in one column the old route and in another, a new straight line drawn in charcoal, heading for a hollow tree.

quests.desc: A charcoal line on an inn's route-board shows the walking city heading in a straight line for a hollow tree.
quests.pitch: The innkeeper says the walking city has stopped wandering and started to march.

objectives.text: Take the chant tablet from the hermit to the Orc outposts that will help cut.
Take the Drabul chief's tally to the next outpost at Jathsogur.
Take the guide-line bearing from Jathsogur to the hidden court at Silvenar.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The cutters' trail runs through Orc outposts and a hidden court to the walking city and the tree-tomb itself.

consequence.summary: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The cutters' trail runs through Orc outposts and a hidden court to the walking city and the tree-tomb itself.

quests.title: Where the City Walks (II)
quests.desc: The cutters' trail runs through Orc outposts and a hidden court to the walking city and the tree-tomb itself.
quests.pitch: The innkeeper says the walking city has stopped wandering and started to march.

objectives.text: Secure the court seal at Silvenar and join the walking city.
Sever the walking city's final guide-root at the base of Falinesti.
Descend the hollow tree and silence the apostates' chant.

quests.outro: At the tomb I silenced the chant and the city, far behind me, slowed and began, at long last, to turn. A Pact-warden saw me cut the last guide-tree and said nothing. Some silences are a kind of thanks.

consequence.summary: At the tomb I silenced the chant and the city, far behind me, slowed and began, at long last, to turn. A Pact-warden saw me cut the last guide-tree and said nothing. Some silences are a kind of thanks.

quests.title: The Citizens' Orchard

find.text: A thorn-wall plaque at the glade's rim lists forty names in a looping Ayleid script, each pricked out with a thorn. Below it, in Bosmer: 'The Mercy. Never be cut. Never be moved.'

quests.desc: A thorn-wall plaque lists forty Ayleid names with a Bosmer warning never to cut the trees.
quests.pitch: The thorn-wardens say the trees of Woodhearth are leaning, a finger a year, to the south.

objectives.text: Take a leaf from the Woodhearth ring and follow where the trees lean.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The orchard's roots lean through a hedge-maze toward a burned city.

consequence.summary: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The orchard's roots lean through a hedge-maze toward a burned city.

quests.title: The Citizens' Orchard (II)
quests.desc: The orchard's roots lean through a hedge-maze toward a burned city.
quests.pitch: The thorn-wardens say the trees of Woodhearth are leaning, a finger a year, to the south.

objectives.text: Climb the ridge, read the maze as a map and walk it to the burned city's gate.
Carry the orchard leaf to the cistern lamp and let the citizens go home.

quests.outro: I walked the last road with the orchard's leaf in my hand and set it on a melted lamp in the burned city. For an hour the ash-grey terraces were green. The trees will not lean further. They are home.

consequence.summary: I walked the last road with the orchard's leaf in my hand and set it on a melted lamp in the burned city. For an hour the ash-grey terraces were green. The trees will not lean further. They are home.

quests.title: The Truce of Bones

find.text: A prayer-stone beside the falls is cut with eight notches for the Truce's bones. Seven are filled in white. The eighth is red clay, still wet, with a thumb-print.

quests.desc: A prayer-stone at the falls has eight notches for the Truce's bones, and the eighth is wet red clay.
quests.pitch: A priest at Waterdancer Falls says the Truce's eighth bone has not been laid and the two peoples are not speaking of it.

objectives.text: Learn the seven verses at Sren Ja and take them to the monastery of Dokrin.
Recover the pressed leaf from the Dokrin library and trace the hand.
Trace the stolen verse through the Rawlkha market's eleven buyers.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. Each stop on the trail holds a part of the rite, from a tree village and a monastery to an arena and the bone-white henge.

consequence.summary: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. Each stop on the trail holds a part of the rite, from a tree village and a monastery to an arena and the bone-white henge.

quests.title: The Truce of Bones (II)
quests.desc: Each stop on the trail holds a part of the rite, from a tree village and a monastery to an arena and the bone-white henge.
quests.pitch: A priest at Waterdancer Falls says the Truce's eighth bone has not been laid and the two peoples are not speaking of it.

objectives.text: Convince the Arenthia scholar to return the Truce's eighth verse.
Dance the eighth step on the Thizzrini sand and carry the full rite to the henge.
Lay the eighth bone on the altar and renew the Truce.

quests.outro: At the henge I laid the eighth bone on the altar, white as the other seven, and the circle's wind dropped. Bosmer and Khajiit stood on opposite sides and, for the first time in a generation, looked at one another.

consequence.summary: At the henge I laid the eighth bone on the altar, white as the other seven, and the circle's wind dropped. Bosmer and Khajiit stood on opposite sides and, for the first time in a generation, looked at one another.
